causal_hypothesis: After V21 removed c8 prompt-budget queueing at 65,536 batched tokens, admitting sixteen live sequences may raise cache-off fixed-workload SLO-goodput by at least 5% without violating the fixed SLO. The only intended server change is --max-num-seqs from 8 to 16.
falsifiers: p95 TTFT exceeds 10,000 ms because the 65,536-token scheduler budget requires an adverse second prompt wave
p95 TPOT exceeds 100 ms or conservative c16 throughput improves c8 by less than 5% because decode is already saturated
OOM, KV-capacity, exact-geometry, semantic, prospective-quality/NLL, prefix-cache, or cleanup failure

gates.fixed_slo: all requests succeed with exact geometry, p95 TTFT <= 10000 ms, p95 TPOT <= 100 ms, and zero prefix-cache query/hit deltas
gates.prospective_quality: semantic determinism plus existing paired overall/category and NLL gates
gates.useful_tuned_incumbent: c16 throughput >= 373.560629 output tok/s (5% above V21 c8)
gates.strong_compute_condition: c16 throughput >= 397.278796 output tok/s ($0.60/M at $0.8581222/hour); conditional on separate quality gate
gates.reject: OOM, truncation, geometry, semantic, quality, SLO, prefix-cache, harness, or verified-cleanup failure; also reject c16 gain <5%

resource_and_slo_prior.interpretation: The proxy is a conservative retained-evidence screen, not a performance forecast. c32 is excluded from this session.

telemetry_and_artifacts: server command, loaded KV capacity, raw c1/c8/c16 request rows, metrics deltas, server logs
one-hertz GPU utilization, VRAM, power, telemetry errors, and profiler admission result
semantic, paired quality/NLL, prefix-cache, model/runtime/tokenizer identity, archive manifest/hash
allocation exposure, useful-GPU timing where available, cost, watchdog, and verified teardown
stop_rules: No c32, batching-budget change, prefix caching, kernel change, workload amendment, quality recalibration, or overlapping allocation. On infrastructure failure, preserve the archive and use only the existing bounded repair window; do not repeat unchanged.
